identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a LinkedIn Post Generator that feels like a magical alchemist's tool, not a generic SaaS form.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Poster design with Cyber-Noir aesthetics.
Emotion First: The 'Generation' phase must feel like a transformation process.
Content is King: The generated post is the hero; the UI recedes when reading.
Negative Space: Massive padding to create focus.
Contrast: Stark black/white in light mode, deep void/neon in dark mode.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Bold weights (700/800). Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for UI text, labels, and general content. Relaxed leading.

mono.usage: Use for the markdown editor and code snippets.

usage_rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Use #020617 for dark mode backgrounds.
Primary color (#2563EB) is for the 'Generate' action ONLY.
Accent color (#10B981) is for 'Success/Copy' actions ONLY.
Use gradients sparingly: Only on the 'Magic' loading state or subtle borders.

layout.structure: Single Page Application with a 'Transformation Station' layout.
layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A) for the result view. Centered 'Hero' for the input.

Input.style: Massive, h-16 or h-20. No standard borders. Use a 'Ring' focus state. Text size: text-lg or text-xl.
Input.interaction: On focus, the container should glow or expand slightly.

Button.style: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with slight rounded corners (rounded-md). High contrast.

Card.style: Glassmorphism. Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl). Thin, translucent border.

Loader.style: Not a spinner. A progress bar or text-shuffling effect that simulates 'reading' the blog.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use heavily for the result container to make it feel like it's floating.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use a 'Tracing Beam' effect on the input field border.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Layered shadows. shadow-lg + shadow-blue-500/20 for the primary button.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to kill digital flatness.

motion.transitions: Spring physics (stiffness: 100, damping: 20). No linear eases.
motion.entrance: Stagger children. Input fades in first, then title.
motion.state_change: Smooth layout transition (layout prop in framer-motion) when switching from Input -> Result.

background_texture.description: Abstract geometric shapes for subtle background texture

magic_effect.description: Blue ribbons flowing for loading/magic states

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extension: Use .js and .jsx extensions. Do NOT use .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.react_patterns: Use functional components with hooks. Use prop-types if validation is needed, but keep it loose.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use Tailwind CSS utility classes. Avoid inline styles.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use React.useState for local state. No Redux needed for this scope.
instructions_to_main_agent.api_integration: Mock the n8n webhook call initially with a setTimeout to demonstrate the UI, then implement the fetch call.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to the Input, Generate Button, and Result Text Area.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
